title: Does Not Keep Warm
text: Does Not Keep Warm. It's big, it's bulky and for what? I can't store the tortillas in it, it's only for keeping them warm while serving. Okay, I can understand that... But what I can't understand is that it doesn't keep the tortillas warm any better than on a plate with a paper towel over them. I'm pressed for space in the kitchen and this bulky thing is basically useless and just takes up space. I've decided it will make a nice cactus garden container but it's a shame to throw out the top. Oh, Nordic Ware, I trusted you for your products.

product_metadata.title: Nordic Ware Microwave Tortilla and Pancake Warmer, 10-Inch,Orange
features: Perfect for warming or reheating more than a dozen tortillas
Place warmer in microwave to ensure everyone at the table receives hot, fresh tortillas at the same time
Also great for pancakes, crepes, waffles, or pita bread

Use and care: 1. Before initial use and after subsequent uses, hand wash with warm soapy water 2. For microwave and serving use only 3. With tortillas inside warmer and lid in place, place in microwave and heat 30 to 45 seconds
description: Whether keeping pancakes ready for the breakfast table for those big weekend brunches or having warm tortillas on standby for your upcoming fiesta, the Nordic Ware Tortilla & Pancake Warmer will be your sidekick! Made from BPA and melamine-free plastic, the container is made to be microwave-safe, and it is perfect for holding crepes, pita bread, and waffles to keep warm as well. Proudly made in the USA, the Nordic Ware Tortilla & Pancake Warmer is a reliable tool for those big breakfasts or outdoor dinner parties!
